source_text: Nonnulli quaerunt de libris qui in Scripturis nominantur nec tamen in canone ecclesiae leguntur. Apostoli et evangelistae nonnumquam exempla protulerunt quae in apocryphis inveniuntur; nec tamen ideo locus apocryphis ad auctoritatem dandus est. Non transferendi sunt termini aeterni quos statuerunt patres. Nobis non est absque periculo tale quid praesumere. De praesenti titulo tenemus editionem: Canticum Canticorum quod est Salomoni.
pass_a_gloss: Some ask about books which in Scriptures are-named nor-yet in canon of-church are-read. Apostles and evangelists sometimes examples brought-forward which in apocrypha are-found; nor-yet therefore place to-apocrypha unto authority is-to-be-given...
pass_b_english: Some ask about books named in the Scriptures yet not read in the church’s canon. Apostles and evangelists sometimes brought forward examples found in apocrypha; yet not for that reason is a place of authority to be given to apocrypha. [[The eternal boundaries are not to be moved, which our fathers set >> Bible:Proverbs 22:28]]. For us it is not without danger to presume such a thing. For the present title we hold the reading: the Song of Songs, which is Solomon’s.
